recommendation: Keep the source fix. It preserves the already-applied Provenance model while removing stale active-source names and a stale generated-definition anchor that could mislead readers into looking for removed choice elements.
issue_request: FHIR-15659 was a Published/Persuasive Security change request asking to remove redundant Provenance identifier/reference choice elements such as Provenance.entity.what[x], Provenance.agent.who[x], and Provenance.agent.onBehalfOf[x] after logical references were introduced through Reference.identifier.
initial_application: The primary source model was applied by commit 6c0a0563b3ac6a188b713f2f1a04ff26229100cf, which changed the Provenance agent and entity elements from Identifier|Reference choices to plain Reference elements and removed the separate entity identifier search parameter. Current source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml already has Provenance.agent.who, Provenance.agent.onBehalfOf, and Provenance.entity.what as Reference elements without [x] choice names.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows Meta is an active normative type, Resource/Meta route to the Resource page, and Provenance is an active resource, so source/datatypes/meta.xml and source/resource/resource-notes.xml are current-build inputs. FHIR-13694 established the Reference.identifier logical-reference behavior that made the old Provenance choices redundant. FHIR-49893 later corrected adjacent Provenance.entity.what wording from whatIdentity to what.identifier and supports keeping the current Reference.identifier guidance.
reconciliation: Changed source/resource/resource-notes.xml and source/datatypes/meta.xml so their text and links refer to Provenance.entity.what and Provenance.agent.who instead of obsolete Provenance.entity.what[x] and Provenance.agent.who[x] names.
source_changes: source/resource/resource-notes.xml: updated the Provenance.entity.what link target and display text from the old [x] choice element to the current element name.
source/datatypes/meta.xml: updated the Meta.source comment to refer to Provenance.entity.what and Provenance.agent.who rather than old [x] choice elements.

related_jiras.note: Clarified Reference.identifier logical-reference semantics that allowed Provenance to collapse identifier/reference choices.
Corrected adjacent Provenance.entity.what comment wording from whatIdentity to what.identifier, confirming the current Reference.identifier model.
